title: Naturally Sweet Turkish Plum Stuffed
description: A light and refreshing ferment of tender Turkish plums, wrapped in a flavorful mixture of plum jam, lardons-render, and fragrant spices.
instructions: Begin by preparing the plums by rinsing and pat drying them with a paper towel.
Cut the plums in half and remove the pit.
In a pan, heat the lardons-render over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the cumin and paprika, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the plum jam and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Stir in the chopped parsley and season with salt to taste.
Stuff the mixture into the plum halves, dividing it evenly among the 12 plums.
Place the stuffed plums in a molcajete and let ferment at room temperature for 24-48 hours.
Serve the plums chilled, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
